title: The Last Thorn
author: Dominic Coldharbour
blurb: Rafael Okonkwo, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
